answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using hardware attestation. Before routing tasks through the protocol wharf, nodes must run inside secure enclaves, ensuring an adversary cannot forge credentials without authentic silicon. The attacker incurs the verifiable cost of acquiring physical processor units per identity. Integrated through a verification trellis, nodes isolate uncertified replicas. However, this relies on centralized chip fabricators and weakens under side-channel attacks.
